Patchwork CI promised to be free for open source.  Many people told us we were crazy. “How will you make money?” they asked.  Fast forward to today: we’re running on 1,200 repositories.  About 900 of them are open source.  That’s a lot of good things.  Here’s what truly blew my mind:  Across all those repos, 1 in 7 CI failures turned out to be a flaky test.  Let that sink in.  1 in 7.  That’s countless hours of developer time wasted on red builds that weren’t real failures.  Open source didn’t just give us users.  It gave us data, feedback, and a community.  In fact, our most-requested feature — GitLab support — came straight from OSS maintainers, and we shipped it on November 12.  Giving back isn’t charity.  It’s strategy.
